$comment: Forma montada por gimg (assemble) de pedidos aprobados del Portal; cada entrada declara de qué pedido sale y en qué difiere.

cases.subject: A paper boat leaving a quay, its wake drawn as three thin lines, ink grey on off-white.
differences: El cierre de la hoja lleva «full-bleed edge to edge» (identidad vigente, «Encuadre»); el pedido, anterior a esa regla, no. Quitado ese tramo, el prompt montado es el del pedido.
cases.prompt: A paper boat leaving a quay, its wake drawn as three thin lines, ink grey on off-white. Richly detailed engraved antique nautical chart style, like a fine sea chart printed in two inks: many layers of fine lines and hatching, line density increasing in the darker areas to give depth and tone, lines of several weights, crisp and sharp, intricate but calm, premium print quality, high detail, elegant. No photographic rendering, no glow, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, full-bleed edge to edge, no border, no frame. Palette strictly limited to medium cerulean ocean blue #0072a8 and its tints and shades, off-white #fbfcfd, ink grey #13212b and a touch of seaweed green #5d7a6a.

cases.subject: A lighthouse under construction on a small rocky islet in the open sea, seen from slightly above, its round stone tower only half built and wrapped in fine wooden scaffolding with ladders and a small wooden crane, drawn in crisp off-white and ink grey line art with fine engraved shading, small ripples around the rocks.
cases.cleanZone: The lighthouse small on the left third, open water on the right
differences: El bloque de grabado del pedido es una variante propia de la 06 (mar de líneas de ola, batimetría, rosa de los vientos); la hoja tiene un solo bloque literal.
El cierre del pedido añade «no realistic objects», «no horizon, no sky, no clouds» y la colocación al final; la hoja tiene un cierre único por hoja y la colocación va antes del registro (zona).
El sujeto y la frase de paleta (con el alga) coinciden con el pedido palabra por palabra.

cases.subject: A flat graphic seen straight on: a line of small round buoys connected by a single white line, running from left to right across the upper two thirds and stepping up and down like a sequence of steps in a process, white line on medium cerulean blue.
cases.cleanZone: The lower third left clean, flat and empty
differences: El pedido es anterior a la decisión del 2026-11-11 (la 15 de Developer es el barco de papel, q311): lleva boyas y «white», que la hoja veta.
El bloque de grabado del pedido añade «in the cerulean field»; el cierre del pedido añade «Flat graphic, no horizon, no sky, no landscape»; su frase de paleta no lleva el alga.
